children: may retrace toward $87.64 per barrel, as it failed again to break a resistance of $90.38.
A projection analysis on a wave c from $86.22 reveals this 100% level as a key barrier. This wave may either end around $90.38 or extend far above it.

Based on its repeated failures to travel above $90.38, the wave c may have completed. A retracement analysis on the downtrend from $94.81 reveals the resistance at $90.12, the 50% level, which works together with the one at $90.38 to stop the rise.

A break above $90.38 may lead to a gain into the $91.22 to $91.97 range. On the daily chart, the contract looks neutral in a narrow range of $85.74 to $90.41. The bias might be toward the downside, as a rising trendline still suggests a further slide to $82.87.
